g.text: Talos dev + prod · Cloudflare Tunnel → Istio Gateway → ztunnel HBONE mTLS + service waypoint
Ingress GET: 2 retries on 502/503, 9s per try, 30s total
retries, 3s per try, 10s total; rest pass through
20% retry budget, ejection only with >1 replica
Durable recovery stays in the checkout saga (inbox/outbox)
istiod programs ztunnel, the ingress gateway, and the waypoint over xDS; ztunnel carries every enrolled pod hop as HBONE mTLS. Cilium stays the CNI.
